text:
Alice C: kicking off a small staging roll for quant-kernel v2.3 -> staging-bucket-3. int8 fastpath + kernel tune. canary=5% for 30m. monitoring 99p token latency, kv-cache hit-rate, and RSS. ping if you see anything odd.

deploy-bot: Started rollout kernel:v2.3 -> staging-bucket-3 (canary=5%, hold=30m). rollout_id=rb-20260321-3261987654. Check status with `deploybot status rb-20260321-3261987654`.

Ben R: quick q — are we gating on kv-cache hit-rate this time? last fastpath change nudged eviction and caused tail regressions.

Chandra: yes — gating rules from the stage-runbook: 99p token latency increase >15% OR kv-cache hit-rate drop >5% triggers auto-pin. also watch per-node kv-hit since it can be noisy. dashboard: https://telemetry.internal/re/quant-kernel/staging/rb-20260321

Eve M: 10m mark: 99p +3% vs baseline, kv-hit steady overall, but node-7 kv-hit -4.5%. memory RSS unchanged. :thinking_face:

SRE Pager: noted. alert thresholds for staging are set to 12% 99p and -8% kv-hit. ops standing by.

Alice C: thanks — if it stays under 10% 99p and no node breaches -8% kv-hit we continue to expand to staging-bucket-6 at +20% after 45m. Otherwise we pin back to kernel:v2.2.

Ben R: please add a line to release_notes: "int8 fastpath — expected throughput boost; watch kv-cache hit-rate for tail regressions". I'll put the snippet in the PR.

Chandra: also want to make pin command explicit in the runbook. suggested: `deploybot pin kernel:v2.2 --immediate --reason="kv-hit-drop"` so oncall doesn't fumble.

Alice C: good call. I'll add that and update the runbook.

deploy-bot: Command available: `deploybot pin kernel:v2.2 --immediate --reason="kv-hit-drop" --author=AliceC`. To inspect offending nodes: `deploybot metrics rb-20260321-3261987654 --metric=kv_hit --per-node`.

Eve M: 18m mark: node-7 kv-hit -6.3%, node-11 -1.2%. 99p sitting at +7% on the cluster, but node-7 is the clear outlier.

Ben R: that -6.3% is getting close to the staging threshold. Alice, want me to standby to execute the pin if node-7 crosses -8%?

Alice C: yes. escalation policy: if any node < -8% kv-hit AND cluster 99p >12% => immediate pin. if only node-7 hits -8% but cluster 99p <12%, we still pin but mark as limited-node regression and open ticket.

Chandra: logging decision in runbook and adding an automated note to the rollback ticket template. ticket template: INF-ROLLBACK-TEMPLATE attached to the runbook.

Eve M: node-7 just hit -8.4% at 22m. 99p is now +13% cluster-wide.

deploy-bot: Rollout rb-20260321-3261987654 flagged: gating rule breach detected (kv_hit node-7 = -8.4%, cluster 99p = +13%).

Alice C: executing pin now. `deploybot pin kernel:v2.2 --immediate --reason="kv-hit-drop on node-7"`. also draining node-7, opening INF-2345, and adding release_notes entry.

deploy-bot: Pin executed by Alice C. Kernel pinned to v2.2 across staging-bucket-3. Rollback ticket INF-2345 created: https://issues.internal/INF-2345.

Ben R: thanks — can someone grab a short postmortem note for release notes? we should call out the node-level kv-cache sensitivity.

Chandra: I'll draft a 2-line postmortem and link it to INF-2345.

Alice C: great. final status: rollout aborted -> pinned to v2.2. we'll rework fastpath memory heuristics and try again next week with a smaller per-node rollout. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
